title: Slip'N'Sliders
dek: A Bama fan who joined in 2003, lived in the official chat, made banners, ran tournaments, retired for baseball season, un-retired seven weeks later, started the Search for Commish, and came back twenty years on to build the SmallBall ToolKits.

card.name: Chatt. Tide Pride
card.line: Forum ID 2483 · Trade Agent of the Month · also 406751 Dukes of Hazzard, 1930 -XsT-, 770 Redd Dog Wrestling

chapters.title: Joins the forums
chapters.text: Forum ID 2483. Four days later he posts a website for Team Slip'n'Sliders.
quotes: Smallball overtakes another small corner of the world wide web.

chapters.title: The guy who's always in the chat
chapters.text: OSBC, the Official SmallBall Chat, becomes home base. He recruits for the No-LiMiT- clan and earns the forum's Trade Agent of the Month title.
quotes: you were the reason i joined

chapters.title: Chasing the Alice's Park code
chapters.text: In the thick of Commish's code-cracking puzzle, checking everyone's guesses.

chapters.title: The giving don't stop
chapters.text: When Season 100 ends with a free badge and ticket from Commish, he posts a free ticket of his own for whoever grabs it first.
quotes: But the giving dont stop here...

chapters.title: Third Saturday in October
chapters.text: Opens the Bama vs. Tennessee thread for the forum's SEC fans. It runs to 37 posts.

chapters.title: Banners by 425
chapters.text: Opens a banner shop for forum signatures, takes requests and keeps it updated.

chapters.title: Brings back the ORRT
chapters.text: Revives the Official Round Robin Tournament with Eddymvp for 8–10★ teams.

chapters.title: De-hammered
text: For a while he held a chat hammer, the OSBC moderator powers to kick and ban. Then he lost it, alongside Money and Smith. Money noticed his was gone in February 2005, the same week the forum argued over whether the hammers were abusing their power. MaluBro07 still counted "dehammering Money, Slip and Smith" among his favorite OSBC memories when the chat closed.
What happened? Twenty years later, Slip's own best explanation:
quotes: Hey! Who stole my hammer? It's not there anymore!

chapters.title: Time to Bow Out...
chapters.text: Announces he's stepping down from the SmallBall throne (not sure which throne, but he was on one) because baseball season has practice and games every night. The goodbyes roll in, and John the Baptist calls him "Slippay," the name the chat would still use in 2007.
quotes: Slip has a life! Suprise, suprise!

chapters.title: Semi-Coming Out of Retirement
chapters.text: Seven weeks later, with help from jon2s and Ravagin in OSBC, the DT is working again. He's training one team plus a community team: 406751, the Dukes of Hazzard. Club 406751 is still his today.

chapters.title: Clan wars, solved
chapters.text: Asked how a fair clan war could work, he has the answer: every team from every clan plays every team from every other clan.
quotes: So there ya go. Yall can start now.

chapters.title: Double Trouble by XsT
chapters.text: Hosts a weekly two-man tournament series and keeps the winner's list. He and Kindred reach the fourth final on 406751.

chapters.title: Signs the petition
chapters.text: Second name on BP's COMMISH! Protest Petition.

chapters.title: XsT wins PL1
chapters.text: His clan's community team takes First League on a tiebreaker.
quotes: Atta way boys! We got it done!

chapters.title: Wake up Commish!
chapters.text: Posts that he has finally found the problem at SmallBall customer service.

chapters.title: The Search for Commish
chapters.text: Footy is down and the creator has been gone for four months, so he opens a 287-post manhunt. Subtitle: Mission Impossible?

chapters.title: Gooser! Why? This is Torture!
chapters.text: Posts his Season 148 box score, a late-inning heartbreak against Gooser, and invites everyone to share theirs. bigdogv65 calls it very good sport.

chapters.title: The ghost
chapters.text: Spots the infamous black bold letters of Commish in Who's Online, then watches them disappear.
quotes: Slip'N'Sliders, on why the Search kept going

chapters.title: Calls it
chapters.text: In Greek Wizard's goodbye thread, he predicts what happens next.
quotes: A new community will pop up, mark my words.

chapters.title: RIP OSBC
chapters.text: The official chat shuts down. chspogo remembers saying hi to him at 2 am and waiting half an hour for no answer.
quotes: What will I be known for except the guy that is ALWAYS in the chat?

chapters.title: Misses the return
chapters.text: Commish finally walks back into chat. Slippay is in school. He gets the chat log by email, which is how it survived.

chapters.title: Back for Season 484
chapters.text: Comes back with the relaunch and builds the SmallBall ToolKits: the Club Kit, the Broadcast Kit, Hold the Hill, the Tournaments pages, and this Lore Vault.

sources: Slip'N'Sliders' post history in the forum archive
note: Built from his own forum posts and the threads he was in. Contact details, birthdays and personal matters are left out on purpose.
